name: skip-expression
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP substring('x','bad') LIMIT 1

name: skip-parameter-negative
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP $s LIMIT 1

name: skip-expression-negative
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP -1 LIMIT 1

name: skip-string
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP 'bad' LIMIT 1

name: skip-parameter-valid
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP $s LIMIT 1

name: limit-capacity
query: MATCH (n:AbsentType) WHERE true RETURN 1 AS x ORDER BY x SKIP 0 LIMIT 2147483647
